subject: Encord
text:
Johnny,

I read Steve's article with ESA talking about how Blinkfire owns it's
technology stack, including your computer vision and AI  models, so wanted
to reach out to see if you'd be open to a quick chat on what we're building?

We recently started working with Hudl, Veo and Spiideo on developing sports
analytics computer vision models with the goal of speeding up their
expansion into new sports & new products releases.

We're mostly assisting with improving model quality / delivery speed while
keeping development costs low as they scale through better end-to-end data
mgmt and by allowing them to curate/annotate high resolution videos
natively.

Not sure how familiar you are with Encord, we're a data development
platform built for advanced computer vision and multimodal AI teams to
build better models (~5 years old, 70+ employees & raised $50M+ funding)

Would you be open to a quick virtual coffee with our leadership team in the
coming weeks? It'd be great to introduce ourselves & get your feedback.
We're pretty open next week Thursday/Friday afternoon PT, however happy to
work around your schedule!
